rootCause: Record reward presentation started only when prepare/finalize reached the existing coin command. It was not wired to confetti completion, but network latency could place it after confetti.
change: The durable local journal stages its existing 10-coin daily reward without sending a monetary request. AdventureReady releases that presentation when the logged heading reports visible, concurrently with confetti. Finalize reuses the same ticket/operation ID and authoritative receipt.
preserved: Daily record-first key, reward cap, actual server reward amount and authorization
Journal draft payload, server draft idempotency, offline retry and duration/start/settlement rules
Confirmed wallet reconciliation and rollback on definitive rejection
Existing ambiguous queued operations keep their ticket until reconciled
Other reward scenes retain their existing release timing
deduplication: Persisted rewardPresented marker and the coin ledger prevent replays on rerender/reentry/restart; stale pairing-only reservations are cancelled, account changes remain fenced.
